text:
Anya (Growth): Quick kickoff idea small trial: 300 users get a 'Starter Pack' (30 tokens) + a themed prompt bundle. Goal: move more users to 2+ meaningful requests in 7 days. Agree?

Jess: Sounds good. I'll build 3 bundles: dev, marketing, docs-summary. Each bundle = 3 prompts + one how-to line. A/B two subject lines for the email.

Samir: Routing plan: tag cohorts `spack_trial` and `spack_web`. Exclude paid & recent-credit-30d. TTL=7d. Posting config to #eng-infra after review.

Maya: Metrics: primary = pct with >=2 requests day7. Secondary = avg tokens/use and day14 retention. @data-bot pull baseline for last 30d for trials/webinars.

data-bot: queued: report `spack_activation_baseline`. link: https://internal.data/reports/spack_activation_baseline

Michael H: Measurement: randomize bundle assignment 1:1. Also run a tiny qualitative prompt for 25 users on day3. Keep surveys optional.

Anya (Growth): Budget = 300 * 30 tokens = 9k tokens. If lift >=8% we scale. Owners: Anya, Jess, Samir, Maya. Check-in Thurs 9:30am PT.

Jess: Will upload copy + Figma mocks EOD.

Samir: Config draft:
```
experiment: spack_v1
cohorts: ["spack_trial","spack_web"]
credit: 30
ttl: 7d
exclusions: ["paid","credit_30d","high_usage"]
```
Posting now.

Maya: I'll prep dashboard and set regression alert.

Anya (Growth): Great, rolling Monday unless objections. :rocket:
